name: How much does a room renovation cost in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How much does a room renovation cost in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Renovation costs in the Bay Area vary widely depending on the room, materials chosen, and scope of work. A minor bathroom refresh might start from $15,000, while a high-end kitchen renovation could exceed $75,000. These are general estimates; custom cabinetry, high-end fixtures, and structural changes will increase the investment. We offer detailed, transparent estimates after an initial consultation to understand your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Room renovation costs in the Bay Area vary significantly by room, materials, and scope, with estimates provided after consultation.
